title: Security, accessibility, load và release rehearsal
scope_items: Target 1 (Real restore and failing smoke): Deterministic point-in-time snapshot backup & restore rehearsal engine with SHA-256 sidecar verification, double-entry financial ledger balance (debits == credits in integer micro-units), workspace AI credit lot reconciliation, immutable evidence SHA-256 verification, audit sequence continuity (1..N), RPO=0 & RTO<=3600s verification, and Blue/Green candidate deployment smoke gate that automatically rolls back to the retained slot digest on any failing /healthz, /readyz, auth, JSON, ledger, or audit sequence check.

Target 2 (No stale provider/license evidence): Pre-release freshness & entitlement auditor across ai_provider_rates, connector ActionAccessVerification, workflow runtime licenses (Activepieces enterprise embed vs owned Go runtime), and legal compliance checklist (LEG-H-001) that rejects stale/expired/unverified evidence, auto-downgrades unverified native_now capabilities to manual, and preserves LOCAL_IMPLEMENTED status while external human/provider gates remain open.

Target 3 (Tenant/privacy tests across public and internal paths): Public creator directory projection (zero leakage of workspace_id, emails, phones, OAuth tokens, or internal notes), OWASP A10 SSRF validator blocking loopback/RFC1918/link-local/cloud-metadata IPs and non-HTTPS schemes, cross-tenant BOLA/RLS denial, PRIV-2026-02 user:self personal onboarding isolation, GDPR/PDPA export OAuth token redaction, EC-M23-003 concurrent impersonation block, EC-M23-004 override frequency alert (>10/24h alert, >50/24h Super Admin approval gate), EC-M23-005 audit sequence gap Sev1 incident + read-only lock, and AdminComplianceService.

Full-Surface A11y, i18n & Load Benchmarks: Vietnamese (vi, primary) and English (en, secondary) translation catalogs with 100% key parity across Web (messages/vi.json, messages/en.json) and Mobile (app_vi.arb, app_en.arb), region-aware VND/USD/date/number formatters, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast & non-color status badges, modal keyboard focus trap with Escape restoration, semantic landmarks & skip-to-content links across Web and Admin, Flutter >=48x48dp touch target & gesture tap-alternative contracts, and 8-scenario load/SLA benchmark evaluator.
verified_sub_slices: Database Migration 00046: Creates data_subject_requests (with ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and composite tenant PK), breach_notifications, data_processing_activities, backup_restore_rehearsals, and internal_audit_logs sequence integrity columns/index with narrow app_user/admin_user grants.

Go Internal Admin & Rehearsal Suite: Passes go test -race -count=1 ./internal/internaladmin/... ./internal/migrate/... ./internal/diagnostics/... ./internal/billing/... ./internal/capability/... ./internal/creatorpro/... covering Targets 1, 2, 3, and load/SLA benchmarks.

CI Smoke & Negative Self-Tests: tooling/ci/smoke_test.sh and tooling/ci/self_test_failure.sh verify real API/Admin-API process isolation, premature readyz rejection, and tampered backup SHA-256 sidecar rejection.
Web & Admin SvelteKit Checks, Tests & Production Builds: apps/admin (12 tests) and apps/web (455 tests across 48 test files) pass Vitest, svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), and vite build.
Mobile Flutter Analyzer & Tests: apps/mobile passes flutter analyze and flutter test test/p8_08_security_a11y_release_test.dart.

external_gates.description: Qualified external legal counsel sign-off for Vietnam PDPA Decree 13/2023/ND-CP, GDPR, CCPA, DMCA agent registration, and sub-processor DPAs is required before public launch.

Live production partner approvals, OAuth scopes, and commercial licenses for external social/commerce connectors (TikTok, Shopee, Meta, YouTube, Lazada, Shopify) and commercial AI providers are required before promoting capabilities to native_now in production.
Full staging/production VPS backup restore drill, multi-node k6 load execution, and automated accessibility browser audit require staging infrastructure.
